title: Branches from the public home reach integration as merge requests
goal: kbgit.py bridge <branch> fetches a branch of the publish remote (a cloud session's working branch or a contributor's pull request), rebases it on the integration main, runs the gate and sends it through sync's lanes (content straight to main, code as code/<id>); the publish remote's main moves only by publish; tests.py -k bridge covers a content and a code branch

gates.question: What happens to pull requests opened on the public home?
options: bridged to the integration remote; the pull request closes when publish brings the merge
merged on the public home, then pulled into integration
not accepted: the public home is read-only
gates.recommendation: bridged to the integration remote; the pull request closes when publish brings the merge

notes: Cloud sessions clone only from GitHub and push only their working branch (_answers.md QK-plugin-host-cloud-session-push-automatic), so their work reaches the kb through this bridge.
